title: RE GCSE revision
subtitle: AQA 8062: Christianity, Judaism, Themes A, B, D and E

scopeLabels.2: Paper 2: Themes A, B, D, E

influence: Development: say how it influences believers today (thinks, feels, acts)
Repeat for a second, different belief
different: Second point must clearly differ (other tradition, or agrees versus disagrees)
similar: Second point argues the same way, in new words and with new reasoning
explain-two-source: Source of wisdom and authority (name it)
Application: how the source supports your point. Do this twice.
evaluate: Evaluate: how convincing is each side?
Conclusion: which is stronger, and why?

evaluateChecklist: Argued one side with a developed point
Included religious teaching or a source for that side
Argued a different point of view with a developed point
Included religious teaching or a source for the other side
Evaluated the arguments (how strong or weak each is)
Spelled key terms correctly and wrote in clear paragraphs (SPaG)
about:
Built from the school’s revision pack for Year 10 RE (The Priory Academy LSST) and checked against the AQA GCSE Religious Studies A (8062) specification and the 2026 exam format. Questions and model answers were written for revision, they are not real past-paper questions.

Always check anything you are unsure about with your teacher. The official specification is at aqa.org.uk. AQA’s own glossary definitions are used in the Glossary.
